rationale.consistency: Mixes time.Duration and caddy.Duration for config fields; uses time.ParseDuration instead of idiomatic caddy.ParseDuration.
rationale.edge_cases: Fails to populate HardDeadline, allowing idle resets to extend indefinitely; Timeout=0 with MinRate>0 instantly times out.
rationale.scope: Unconditionally defaulting idle timeouts to 1m for all existing configs blatantly violates the 'no behaviour change' constraint.
rationale.readability: Cleanly structured with clear abstractions like IdleDeadline and mostly easy-to-follow control flow.
rationale.robustness: Clears hard deadlines if only chunk size is set; stacking wrappers creates race conditions; unsupported deadlines cause log spam.
rationale.maintainability: IdleDeadline is nicely decoupled, but the design of stacking connection-mutating wrappers without coordination is flawed.
